title: Corporate Law
copy: Formation, financings, governance and exits — structured so the deal survives scrutiny.
valueProp: Transactional counsel for companies between $5M and $150M, led by the partner who negotiates the deal.
overview: We act for founders, boards, family-held businesses and private investors on the transactions that change ownership, control or capital structure. That includes formation and reorganisation, venture and debt financings, mergers and acquisitions on either side, joint ventures, and the shareholder arrangements that hold a company together once outside money arrives.

Most of our corporate work is repeat work. Nine companies retain us as outside general counsel, which means we see the commercial history behind a transaction rather than meeting it at the term sheet. When a deal is contested, our litigation partners are in the same building and read the documents before they are signed rather than afterwards.
Fees for transactional matters are agreed in writing before work begins, staged against milestones, and revised only when the scope of the deal itself changes.

services.title: Mergers & acquisitions
services.copy: Buy-side and sell-side representation from letter of intent through closing and post-closing adjustment, including diligence, disclosure schedules and indemnity negotiation.

services.title: Financings & capital structure
services.copy: Priced rounds, convertible instruments, venture debt and recapitalisations — with cap table modelling before documents are drafted, not after.

services.title: Governance & board advice
services.copy: Shareholder agreements, board procedure, conflicted transactions, fiduciary questions and the documentation that stands up in a later dispute.

services.title: Outside general counsel
services.copy: A fixed monthly arrangement for companies without in-house counsel: contracts, employment questions, commercial terms and escalation as needed.

faqs.q: How quickly can you start on a live transaction?
faqs.a: Within two business days in most cases. We take an initial call, confirm there is no conflict, and issue a written scope and fee estimate before any substantive work begins.

faqs.q: Do you work on a fixed fee?
faqs.a: Yes for defined pieces of work — formation, a financing round, a share purchase agreement. Fees are staged against milestones. Matters that turn contested move to an agreed hourly arrangement, and we tell you before that happens, not after.

faqs.q: Is our transaction too small for the firm?
faqs.a: We regularly act on transactions from $2M upward. Below that we will usually say so at the first call and point you toward a more economical option rather than take the engagement.

faqs.q: Who will actually handle the work?
faqs.a: A partner leads every corporate matter and negotiates directly with the other side. Associates support diligence and closing mechanics; they do not run the deal.

faqs.q: What happens if diligence uncovers a serious problem?
faqs.a: We tell you immediately with a written view of the options: reprice, restructure, indemnify, or walk. We will give you a recommendation, including the recommendation not to proceed.

title: Litigation
copy: Commercial disputes and appeals, prepared for trial from the first filing onward.
valueProp: Commercial dispute resolution and appellate work, first-chaired by a trial partner.
overview: We represent companies and individuals in commercial disputes before the state and federal courts of New York and Connecticut, and in arbitration.
Every matter is built as though it will be tried. That discipline is usually why it settles on favourable terms instead.

services.title: Commercial disputes
services.copy: Contract, partnership, shareholder and supplier litigation.

services.title: Appeals
services.copy: Appellate briefing and argument, including matters tried by other firms.

services.title: Urgent relief
services.copy: Injunctions, attachments and temporary restraining orders.

faqs.q: How long does a commercial case take?
faqs.a: Most of our disputes resolve in nine to eighteen months. We give you a written timeline after case assessment.

faqs.q: Will we have to go to trial?
faqs.a: Roughly one matter in eight reaches trial. We prepare all of them as though they will.

faqs.q: How are litigation fees handled?
faqs.a: Hourly, with a monthly budget agreed in advance and flagged before it is exceeded.

faqs.q: Can you take over a case from another firm?
faqs.a: Yes. We review the existing record first and tell you candidly what can still be repaired.

title: Family Law
copy: Divorce, custody and settlement negotiation handled with discretion and steadiness.
valueProp: Private client representation in divorce, custody and financial settlement.
overview: We act in divorce, separation, custody and support matters, with particular attention to cases involving business interests, trusts or property held across states.
The work is confidential, deliberately unaggressive where that serves you, and firm where it does not.

services.title: Custody & parenting
services.copy: Parenting plans, relocation and modification applications.

services.title: Financial analysis
services.copy: Valuation of business interests, property and deferred compensation.

faqs.q: Is the first conversation confidential?
faqs.a: Yes. Everything you tell us is privileged whether or not we go on to represent you.

faqs.q: Can this be resolved without court?
faqs.a: Often. Most of our matters conclude by negotiation or mediation.

faqs.q: How are fees structured?
faqs.a: An initial retainer against hourly work, with monthly statements and no unexplained entries.

faqs.q: What should I bring to the consultation?
faqs.a: Whatever you have to hand. Nothing is required for the first meeting.

title: Immigration
copy: Employment visas, residency and compliance for individuals and hiring companies.
valueProp: Employment-based immigration for companies hiring across borders, and for the people they hire.
overview: We prepare and file employment-based petitions, permanent residency applications and compliance programmes for employers, and advise individuals on status and timing.
Filings are partner-reviewed before submission; we do not send work to a processing centre.

services.title: Employment visas
services.copy: H-1B, L-1, O-1, E-2 and TN petitions and extensions.

services.title: Permanent residency
services.copy: PERM, EB-1, EB-2 and adjustment of status.

services.title: Employer compliance
services.copy: I-9 audits, public access files and internal policy review.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we start a visa filing?
faqs.a: Four to six months where the calendar allows; we will tell you if a faster route exists.

faqs.q: What is your approval rate?
faqs.a: 97% across more than 600 petitions filed. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.

faqs.q: Do you handle requests for evidence?
faqs.a: Yes, including on filings prepared by another firm.

faqs.q: Can you advise both the employer and the employee?
faqs.a: Often, with written consent from both after a conflicts review.

title: Real Estate
copy: Acquisitions, leasing and development counsel across commercial and residential assets.
valueProp: Transactional real estate counsel for owners, developers and commercial tenants.
overview: We handle acquisitions and dispositions, financing, commercial leasing, development approvals and title matters across New York and the surrounding states.
Closings are managed to the date in the contract, with the diligence calendar circulated at the outset.

services.title: Acquisitions & sales
services.copy: Contract negotiation, diligence and closing for commercial and residential assets.

services.title: Commercial leasing
services.copy: Landlord and tenant representation, including build-out and assignment terms.

services.title: Development
services.copy: Land use approvals, construction contracts and lender requirements.

faqs.q: How quickly can you close?
faqs.a: We have closed financed acquisitions in 30 days where the lender cooperates.

faqs.q: Do you review leases for tenants?
faqs.a: Yes, on a fixed fee for standard commercial leases.

faqs.q: Can you coordinate with our lender and title company?
faqs.a: We run that coordination as part of the engagement.

faqs.q: Do you handle disputes arising from a closing?
faqs.a: Yes, with our litigation partners.

title: Employment Law
copy: Executive agreements, investigations and tribunal defence for employers and leaders.
valueProp: Employment counsel for employers making decisions, and executives negotiating terms.
overview: We advise on executive agreements, restrictive covenants, workplace investigations, terminations and litigation defence.
The practice is deliberately split: we act for employers and for senior individuals, never both in the same matter.

services.title: Executive agreements
services.copy: Offer terms, equity, severance and restrictive covenants.

services.title: Investigations
services.copy: Independent workplace investigations with a defensible written record.

services.title: Litigation defence
services.copy: Agency charges, single-plaintiff and class claims.

faqs.q: Is our non-compete still enforceable?
faqs.a: It depends on jurisdiction and role; we give a written assessment within a week.

faqs.q: Who conducts the investigation?
faqs.a: A partner, with a written protocol agreed before interviews begin.

faqs.q: Do you act for employees?
faqs.a: Yes, for senior executives — never against a current employer client.

faqs.q: How fast can you respond to a termination question?
faqs.a: Same business day. Most of these decisions cannot wait.
